title: Zolder (Alternate & Grand Prix) | In Depth Track Guide | iRacing

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: Brake after the orange strip on the wall.
corners.line: Turn in close to the wall on the right.
corners.mistakes: Don't be afraid to get close to the wall.

corners.label: T1
corners.line: Turn in close to inside curb, late apex
corners.exit: Use all track on left, swing back to right
corners.mistakes: Taking too much inside curb destabilizes car

corners.label: T4
corners.braking: break right there at that little grass spot
corners.exit: throttle up, use a bit of gravel on the left
corners.mistakes: be very careful past the white line

corners.label: T5
corners.line: take flat part of curb on first apex
corners.mistakes: take too much curb on first apex

corners.braking: braking quite after the 100 meter board
corners.line: flat part of the curb doesn't unsettle the car
corners.exit: aim for the end of this white sausage curb
corners.mistakes: more than halfway on any of the white sausage curbs is off track

corners.braking: Brake hard once car is straight after brake marker.
corners.line: Keep straight, use half of the inside curb.
corners.mistakes: Using too much curb leads to off track.

corners.line: Use curb on right, curve on left
corners.mistakes: Go full throttle too soon, wash out wide

corners.label: T7
corners.line: Straight line, use as much kerb as possible

corners.label: T8
corners.exit: Use track dip to pull through corner

corners.line: aim for orange painted wall at end
corners.exit: use curb on right, take more track with white line
corners.mistakes: don't get too close to wall

corners.braking: keep eye on orange paint for turn-in
corners.line: turn in a little bit of track on the inside
corners.exit: lift fully then slowly lift less and less until you can find the point
corners.mistakes: car will be all over the place if you don't have confidence, use the dirt on the right to oversteer the car

corners.label: T10
corners.braking: Brake slightly after 100m board, between 100m and bio racer sponsorship
corners.line: Turn in using inside curve, apex using more inside curve
corners.exit: Open throttle, use track on left
corners.mistakes: Careful with wall on left and grass

general_tips: confidence is key for this corner
use throttle to turn the car in
use the dirt on the track as a reference point
use more of the second apex and less of the first
aim for the end of the white sausage curb
Focus on the second curb of the chicane for a better exit.
Fool around with lines and braking points to gain time
use curb on exit for more speed
Keep to the left for a millisecond gain
